title: Logs, metrics, and traces answer different questions
subtitle: Choose the signal that helps diagnose an incident
learning_objective: Choose logs, metrics, or traces based on the debugging question.

source_refs.title: OpenTelemetry documentation

scenes.title: LATENCY JUST SPIKED
scenes.body: The dashboard says requests are slow. Which telemetry helps you find the cause?

scenes.title: Three views of the system
scenes.body: Metrics summarize behavior over time. Logs record individual events. Traces connect spans across the path of one request.

scenes.title: Connect them with context
scenes.body: Consistent service names, timestamps, trace IDs, and useful attributes help move from a metric spike to a specific request and its events.

scenes.question: Which signal is best for seeing time spent across several services in one request?
scenes.explanation: A distributed trace links spans across services and shows where request time was spent.

scenes.title: Remember this
scenes.body: Metrics show patterns, logs show events, and traces show request journeys. They work best together.
